seoTitle: Delete Mail in Hostinger and Clean Up Webmail
metaDescription: Remove an email account or clean out your inbox in Hostinger's Webmail, with steps for both a full delete and a simple inbox cleanup.
intro: Keeping your Hostinger email organized means occasionally deleting old accounts or clearing out clutter in your inbox. This guide covers both fully removing an email account and simply cleaning out messages through Webmail.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Go to the Hostinger website, click Login, and enter your account credentials.

steps.heading: Open the Emails section
steps.body: From the hPanel dashboard, click Emails, then find the domain associated with the email you want to manage and click Manage.

steps.heading: Delete an email account
steps.body: Under Email Accounts, find the address you want to remove, click the three-dots button next to it, select Delete, and confirm the removal.

steps.heading: Clean up messages instead
steps.body: If you just want to declutter without deleting the account, click Webmail next to the email address, go to the Mail section, select messages, and hit Delete.

steps.heading: Confirm the change
steps.body: Whether you deleted the full account or just messages, double-check the email list or inbox to confirm the change took effect.

faq.question: What's the difference between deleting an email account and cleaning up an inbox?
faq.answer: Deleting the account removes it and all its contents permanently, while cleaning up through Webmail just clears specific messages while keeping the account active.

faq.question: Where do I manage email accounts in Hostinger?
faq.answer: Go to the Emails section in hPanel, find your domain, and click Manage to see all associated email accounts.

faq.question: Is deleting an email account permanent?
faq.answer: Yes, confirming the delete permanently removes the account and its contents, so make sure you no longer need it first.

faq.question: How do I access Webmail for a specific address?
faq.answer: Click the Webmail link next to that email address within hPanel's email management section.
